issues.description: Field 'numberOfTutors': the problem statement UML (Lecture class attributes) declares numberOfTutors as type int, but the solution implementation declares the field as type short. This causes a type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution and can confuse students about which type to use for the field and related getters/setters/constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of the field numberOfTutors consistent with the problem specification by changing the solution field to int. Update any dependent code (the constructor parameter, the setter parameter type, and any internal assignments) so the field and its API use int to match the UML and expected tests.

issues.description: Constructor parameter for Lecture(String, int, int, int, ...): the problem statement UML implies the fifth constructor parameter (numberOfTutors) should be int, but the solution's constructor signature declares that parameter as short. This constructor parameter type mismatch conflicts with the UML and will confuse students implementing the constructor to match the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Lecture constructor parameter type for numberOfTutors from short to int in the solution. Also update the corresponding field declaration and the setter signature to int so the constructor signature, field, and accessor methods consistently use int as specified in the UML.
